name: Record a fall
summary: Turn Gravity on, drop a figure, and press Record fall. The way it fell is kept as a small clip you can play again from anywhere, put on the Beat strip, and share with friends later.
helps: Make a figure fall the same way every time, without running the physics again.
where2d: Animate panel: Record a fall, under Beat strip.
whereVR: Capture face > Animate > Beat strip > Record fall

d2: Select a figure and turn Gravity on so it can fall.
Open the Animate panel and press Record fall, then let the figure go.
When it has landed, press Stop recording.
Stand the figure up somewhere else and press Play last fall.
Press Add ragdoll beat to put the fall on the Beat strip.
vr: Select a figure and turn Gravity on so it can fall.
Open the wrist menu, then Capture face, Animate, Beat strip, and press Record fall.
Let the figure go. When it has landed, press Stop recording the fall.
Press Play fall to see it again from wherever the figure is now.
Press Add ragdoll beat to put it on the strip, and Undo last recording to take it away.
use: it records only after you press Record fall
the fall plays the same from any place and any way the figure faces
a recording is about 7 KB a second, and a fall that is too long is refused with a message
Undo takes the last recording away
Stop puts the figure back where it was

changes.note: You can now record a rag doll fall and play it again, so turn Gravity on, press Record fall, let the figure go, press Stop recording, then Play fall or Add ragdoll beat.
